outer_carapace_asa_structural.structural_purpose: Mantis helicoid energy-scattering outer shell (Matte ASA). Sliced with 5 heavy wall loops at high heat to ensure maximum impact shatter resistance and complete UV weatherproofing. Retains absolute continuous line vectors around the twisting sinusoidal wave tracks to prevent internal structural stress weak points.

lotus_effect_skin_papillae.structural_purpose: Superhydrophobic lotus leaf micro-papillae skin (Matte ASA). Sliced at a dense 0.12mm layer height to capture the swept flared base fillets. Hardcodes an active 45% fan speed boost combined with a 0.15mm wipe-while-retracting distance override. This freezes the hot ASA right at the tip mouth and cuts off micro-oozing, completely eliminating plastic hair webbing to ensure the fluid-deflection channels stay perfectly hollow and open.

internal_crumple_web_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: 3D Re-entrant auxetic honeycomb shock web (95A Dense TPU). Sliced with top and bottom layers dropped to 0 to keep the bow-tie honeycomb channels hollow and wide-open for sweat-vapor ventilation. Enforces a flat 0.00mm Z-hop lift and a strict 18.0mm/s speed cap around the angled re-entrant struts to eliminate retraction stringing, ensuring the material can compress and expand auxetically with zero physical openings.
